posts.text: Everyone keeps trying to read the tea leaves of what Trump wants to end this war, and what Iran wants. We're looking in the wrong place. They're irrelevant. The only comments that matter are Netanyahu's. Israel is in charge. They'll make the decision on when this war is over.

I want to be clear, I don't speak for @saikatc or Corbin Trent or anyone at @justicedems. They also don't speak for me. All good people, but we're individuals. I hope @AOC becomes a lion for the movement and shows me how wrong I am by being an amazing leader fighting for justice.

I can't believe @AOC said @justicedems didn't deserve credit for her victory. The ego has landed! She definitely wouldn't have won without @saikatc and Corbin Trent. Also, @TheYoungTurks did 34 videos on her and got her over a million views and our audience raised $2.5M for Justice Dems overall.

No one is looking for a trophy. She has been insecure about this from day one. No one is taking credit away from you! You did a great job in the race! That's why Saikat went all in on you. But it's comm

Two million Christians live in Lebanon. How many are Israel allowed to kill with our money? Do we have to call them terrorists if they fight back against the Israeli invasion? Do they have right to defend themselves or do they have no rights, just like Israel’s Muslim neighbors?

This is Netanyahu making clear that our Vice President reports to him. And that he’s in charge of what terms we’re considering in negotiations. Zero enrichment is purposely near impossible so we can stay in the war forever. He’s gloating here that’s what blew up the negotiations.


Barak Ravid (@BarakRavid)

Netanyahu at a cabinet meeting: "I spoke yesterday with Vice President J.D. Vance. He called me from his plane on his way back from Islamabad. He reported to me in detail, as this administra

And someone added a horned figure floating above him to the original picture. And that’s the version he sent out. What is that? Why was it added? And did Trump know? Because the president sending out demonic imagery is not anywhere near normal. The issue is his state of mind.

I can't get over the blasphemous picture Trump put up comparing himself to Jesus Christ. Either he doesn't know that you're not supposed to compare yourself to the Lord and Savior, which is a stunning level of ignorance, or he did it on purpose to disrespect and mock people. Wow.

Yes, he definitely believes this. His arrogance and hubris are clinical and blasphemous. 

And he knows so little about Christianity that he doesn’t even know you’re not supposed to compare yourself to Jesus Christ. And yet he poses as the Savior. It doesn’t get worse than that.


Riley Gaines (@Riley_Gaines_)

Why? Seriously, I cannot understand why he'd post this. Is he looking for a response? Does he actually think this? 

Either way, two things are true. 

1) a little humility would serve hi

Now, Christian Armenians have joined their Muslim brothers in fighting against the Israelis in Southern Lebanon. That’s their home, too! Israel is trying to take it by force. Do the Lebanese have a right to defend themselves? Do Christians have a right to defend themselves?
NotAnotherDollar.com

Not a single more American should die for Israel. Not a single more dollar should go to Israel. Why are they the boss of us? Bring our troops and our money back home! #NotAnotherDollar


Washington Journal (@cspanwj)

"Is Donald Trump so stupid that he didn't know [Iran would] retaliate? And the answer is yeah, he might be that dumb. That's why Netanyahu said in the Situation Room 'Oh they'll surrender and grovel at your feet.'"

@cenkuygur discusses the latest in Iran, including President Trump

We can’t stay in this war. We’re flirting with global economic disaster. And Israel won’t let us leave. I don’t know how this gets resolved. How much economic pain will America bear before it starts to chafe at this absurd level of control that another country exercises on us?

If Trump is still making offers like this, then he’s just a sad servant of Israel. He’s a puppet through which they talk. This offer doesn’t help American interests one bit. I don’t think we’re in charge of our own government.

Is this a joke? Does Trump just not understand that we have lost leverage since the war began. These are the same maximalist Israeli demands as before the war began. Why the hell would they take that? This is not a peace offer, it’s an F U note from Israel to Iran.


Mary Margaret Olohan (@MaryMargOlohan)

U.S. official tells @realDailyWire that these are the United States' red lines for Iran: 

- Iran must end all uranium enrichment
- Dismantle all major nuclear enrichment facilities 
- Retriev

Only way out is to make this simple deal: 1. We leave. 2. They open up Strait of Hormuz. Period. No interfering with their enrichment or foreign policy. They're never going to agree to that and it's not our business. If Israel doesn't like that, that's their problem, not ours.

Trump is retaliating against Iran by double closing the Strait of Hormuz. So, now Iran's oil can't get out either. Ok, but what will that do to oil prices? Make them much higher!! And that will hurt our economy very badly. So, ironically, that only INCREASES Iran's leverage.

I think we’re used to getting everything we want. But that’s not how the real world works. The Iranians have closed the Strait of Hormuz and can now use the world economy as leverage. I don’t think we understand the position we’re in. Israel has put us in an untenable place.

The old dividing line was Left vs. Right. And I’m sure we’ll get back to that at some point. But right now, the new dividing lines are Patriots vs. Israelis. Grassroots vs Establishment. American forces have assembled online and can’t wait to defeat the establishment and MSM.

It's weird how little national media is talking about this. Do they think it's a national security issue to discuss this? Do they think Iran is unaware of this calculus. They say they're perfectly aware of it. In fact, they're trying to get us to waste our defensive missiles.

Here's a critical part of the war no one is talking about - we're running low on interceptor missiles. Once we run out, we have to leave. Otherwise our ships are sitting ducks. So, we might not have a choice on whether to end the war. Staying past that can only make things worse.
